newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: TransAlta NZ 10-year bond yield set at 8.86 pct.
newsitem.headline: TransAlta NZ 10-year bond yield set at 8.86 pct.

text.p: TransAlta NZ Ltd on Friday confirmed the yield and coupon at which its 10-year senior bonds would be issued on October 1 would be 8.86 percent, CS First Boston said.
TransAlta NZ, formed from the merger of EnergyDirect and Capital Power, is issuing shares, capital notes and bonds to shareholders of the two power companies.

The total issue of 10-year bonds is NZ$111 million, of which $88 million were this week placed with local institutions by co-managers CS First Boston and National Bank of New Zealand Ltd. The A-rated senior bonds, maturing on October 1, 2006, were placed at a 76-point margin over government stock.

TransAlta will be also be issuing seven-year bonds maturing October 1, 2003 at a yield and coupon of 8.81 percent and five-year capital notes maturing October 2001 at a yield and coupon of 9.84 percent, CS First Boston said.
